paragraphs: SmartWorks sells SmartWorks Compass, a platform that helps electric, water, and gas utilities improve data accuracy, automate operational workflows, and uncover insight through analytics and AI. The platform covers data management, operational intelligence, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities, and its modular structure lets a utility begin with one priority and add capabilities as requirements change. Compass is built to sit alongside systems a utility already runs, and SmartWorks integrates with CIS, AMI, AMR, customer engagement, and other utility environments.

SmartWorks Athena is the AI line, letting utility staff explore operational information in everyday language rather than through custom reports or technical queries. Athena reaches meter-to-cash, AMI, CIS, and operational data through plain-English questions, and it can also support compatible CIS and MDM environments outside SmartWorks Compass.

SmartWorks Connect is a separate portal line that utilities use to give residential and commercial customers self-service access, usage insights, billing details, alerts, and service tools. These pages name electric, water, gas, and multi-commodity utilities as the customers for all of it, and place that work across North America and the Caribbean. The company describes itself as part of Harris Utilities, working alongside established CIS, customer engagement, and complementary utility technology providers.

quote.text: SmartWorks solutions reflect the data, operational, and customer-service requirements of electric, water, gas, and multi-commodity utilities.
